summary: Frontend-only UI test of StudentAiChatWidget placement/drag. Logged in as demo student. Desktop 1920x1080: collapsed open button positioned at right_gap=24px, bottom_gap=24px (bottom-right corner as expected). Sidebar 'Keluar' (Logout) button rendered at x=12,y=1028,w=172,h=40 in the left sidebar — no overlap with widget (widget at x=1840). Drag test: opened widget (initial box x=1536,y=596), dragged from student-ai-chat-drag-handle to (500,300); widget moved to x=320,y=277 (delta ~1200px x, ~319px y) and remained fully inside viewport. Chat input remained functional and typing works after move. Close→reopen works after drag. Mobile 390x844: collapsed button at x=310 (within viewport), scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow), opened widget spans x=8..366 (inside viewport, honors calc(100vw-32px)).
critical_code_review_comments: StudentAiChatWidget.jsx clampPosition on resize only clamps left, not bottom. If viewport height shrinks below current bottom+widget height the widget may go off-screen top; consider clamping bottom too.
startDrag uses pointermove/pointerup on window but does not call setPointerCapture; works OK in tests but on touch devices could drop pointer if the target unmounts.
Widget uses z-40 which is fine vs. sidebar, but ensure any global modal (z-50+) still overlays it — verified visually here.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 scenarios: desktop placement+no-overlap, drag, mobile placement+no-overflow, open/close after move)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Widget testids: student-ai-chat-widget, student-ai-chat-open-button, student-ai-chat-close-button, student-ai-chat-drag-handle, student-ai-chat-input, student-ai-chat-send-button, student-ai-chat-messages. Sidebar Logout label is 'Keluar' (not 'Logout'). Widget default position right:24, bottom:24; drag switches to left/bottom coordinates.
rca of the issue: Original overlap bug (widget bottom-left overlapping sidebar 'Keluar') resolved by initializing position to {right:24, bottom:24, left:null} and drag handler now writes left+bottom (right:null) so post-drag position is preserved. Fix verified in current build.
